description:
Write to tv@sumtv.org, and get your Bible questions answered on a future program!
The following questions are answered in this Q & A program:
1. What is the angel of death spoken about in The Great Controversy and the Bible.
2. Are the 144,000 the only ones alive in the second coming of Jesus?
3. Daniel chapter 8
4. What does the Earth represent and what does it mean the earth helps the woman (Rev 12)
5. How do I give my life to Christ / Practical steps to give myself 100% to Christ
.
.
.
Join us every Tuesday at 4:30pm (Pacific Time) for our weekly episode airing LIVE from the studio!
Only on SUMtv.org! 
Additional Bible studies are available at SecretsUnsealed.org.
